definitions: A war in which a belligerent engages in the complete mobilization of all its available resources and to that effect uses all of its weaponry, engages all of its financial resources, and uses all of its human resources in order to achieve the complete destruction of the enemy's armed forces and the enemy's will to resist.
examples: The government declared an all-out war on drug trafficking.
The company launched an all-out war against its competitors.
